pares.antes: export const abasEscondidas = derived([modoAlianca, activePage, activeEdit], ([$modo, $pagina, $edit]) => new Set(abasEscondidasNoEditor(TODAS, { preparar: $modo === "preparar", noEditor: $pagina === "edit", tipoEditado: ($edit as any)?.type })))
pares.depois: export const abasEscondidas = derived([modoAlianca, activePage, activeEdit, abaLateral], ([$modo, $pagina, $edit, $aba]) => new Set(abasEscondidasNaBiblioteca(TODAS, { preparar: $modo === "preparar", naBiblioteca: $aba === "biblioteca" && $pagina === "show", noEditor: $pagina === "edit", tipoEditado: ($edit as any)?.type })))
